title: Yellowstone's real danger isn't lava. It's water. #Shorts
description:
Yellowstone's most likely "eruption" is steam, not lava. Clogged underground pipes crack, water flashes to steam, and blasts like Biscuit Basin happen every decade or few decades.

▶ Full documentary (Part 1, What's Really Under Yellowstone): https://youtu.be/-vkXqMrSljM
